facts.fact: ANICNS, under the Ministry of Public Health, launched a call for expressions of interest (AMI N° ANICNS/AMI/004/CGMP/2026, deadline 2026-07-12) to set up a national health data centre by public-private partnership, to centralise national health data and ensure interoperability between existing systems using HL7/FHIR.

systems.owner: ANICNS (Ministère de la Santé Publique, Hygiène et Prévoyance Sociale)

note: as_of is the published date, the document giving no separate date for the launch; the centre is at procurement stage and no exchange in service is stated.
